## Professional Summary
Jesús Ortega is a Junior Full-Stack Web Developer and Computer Engineer specializing in the Vue.js ecosystem (Vue 3, Nuxt 3, and Nuxt 4), Node.js, Express, and Supabase (PostgreSQL). He brings hands-on experience building mission-critical enterprise systems, healthcare registry platforms, responsive web apps, and automated workflows with Python and GitHub Actions.

## Core Technical Competencies
- Frontend Engineering: Vue.js (Vue 3, Composition API, `<script setup>`), Nuxt (Nuxt 3 & Nuxt 4), TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), Pinia state management, Tailwind CSS, Nuxt UI, Vuetify, HTML5, CSS3/PostCSS, Vite.
- Backend & Database Architecture: Node.js, Express.js, RESTful API design, Supabase (PostgreSQL, Row-Level Security, Database Schemas), Authentication, CRUD microservices, Python 3.
- DevOps, Automation & Workflow: Git, GitHub Actions (CI/CD pipelines), Discord.js, Pillow (PIL), Postman, Bun, npm.
- Software Engineering Foundations: Object-Oriented Programming, MVC & Component-driven architectures, Data Structures & Algorithms, UI/UX accessibility (WCAG AA compliance).

## Key Software Engineering Projects
- **Fondo de Ayuda Mutua** (Client: Industrias Rodanol S.A.): Comprehensive mutual aid fund and financial administration platform managing loans, worker savings, payroll deductions, user authorization, and PDF accounting reports. Built with Nuxt, Vuetify, Express, and Supabase.
- **Sistema-NH** (Client: CDI Negra Hipólita): Specialized healthcare record management system for tracking immunization histories, medical lot batches, dose intervals, and clinical reports. Built with Vue 3, Vite, Vuetify, Vee-Validate, and Pinia.
- **Fluxora**: Real-time project collaboration and agile task workspace with live status boards and team activity tracking. Built with Nuxt 4, Vue 3, Tailwind CSS, Express, and Supabase.
- **DolarBase**: Real-time foreign exchange monitor and currency calculator delivering live market quotes and historical trends. Built with Vue 3, Vite, Pinia, Tailwind CSS, and financial REST APIs.
- **Academia Expresarte**: Educational portal and booking platform for creative workshops and academic programs. Built with Nuxt 4, Tailwind CSS, Express, and Supabase.
- **RandomCards Automation**: Autonomous scheduled bot generating customized social media cards with automated daily publication cron jobs. Built with Python 3, GitHub Actions, Pillow, and X API v2.
- **RandomDuel**: Interactive gaming and match engine bot for Discord communities. Built with Node.js and Discord.js.
